sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:172518
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 40129 of 2024

Applicant :- Smt. Shashi Devi
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Garun Pal Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1. Heard Sri Garun Pal Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Vijay Kumar, learned AGA for the State-respondent.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 306 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B, 328 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Sadabad, District Hathras during pendency of the trial.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the present matter along with other family members including husband of the deceased.
4. He next submits that however marriage of the deceased was solemnized with the son of the applicant about a year before but as applicant side was poor laborers, therefore, she was not happy with her marriage with the son of the applicant and only due to this reason, she committed suicide by consuming some poisonous substance.
Smt. Shashi Devi vs State Of U.P. on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121457482/
1 5.

entities.text: Shashi Devi vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that viscera report of the deceased also suggests that deceased died due to consumption of Aluminum Phosphide, therefore, prima facie, it appears to be a case of suicidal death.

6. He further submits, there is no specific allegation against the applicant and she is lady and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 27.08.2024.
7. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. However, it reflects that daughter-in-law of the applicant died within a year of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.

10. Further, however, during post mortem the cause of death of the deceased could not be ascertained and viscera was preserved but now viscera report is on record and as per viscera report deceased died due to consumption of Aluminum Phosphide, therefore, argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that it is a case of suicidal death cannot be ruled out, at this stage.

11. Further, applicant is lady and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter,
she is in jail since 27.08.2024.
12.

Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
13. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

14. Let the applicant-Smt. Shashi Devi, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
Smt. Shashi Devi vs State Of U.P. on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121457482/
2 15.

entities.text: Shashi Devi vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

16. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
